selection_method: Doc-led feature selection after 319-record exclusion; cross-check on product, mechanism and workflow, not URL only

targets.lesson_subject: SNAT source-port preservation and IKE UDP port collision
targets.failure_class: IKE NAT traversal fails behind translating firewall
targets.remediation_path: verify port-preserve scope and NAT session collision

targets.lesson_subject: FortiSwitch ingress ACL assignment through centralized template install
targets.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: ACL ingress->ACL group->port template->FortiGate install->FortiSwitch TCAM
targets.failure_class: ACL configured but not enforced on port
targets.evidence_pattern: install preview ACL group reference and switch counters
targets.remediation_path: verify FortiSwitch central mode group assignment and hardware support

targets.lesson_subject: Model-device onboarding for central logging and authorization
targets.failure_class: device appears online but log configuration denied
targets.evidence_pattern: Device Manager status, faz.perm and FortiGate connection status
targets.remediation_path: set appropriate permission and validate serial/model and PSK

targets.lesson_subject: ERSPAN mirror encapsulation and FortiLink ISL conflict
targets.failure_class: mirroring inactive because source equals nexthop ISL
targets.evidence_pattern: mirror status auto-config-state and collector reachability
targets.remediation_path: remove ISL conflict or adjust FortiLink sniffer and source port

targets.lesson_subject: DTIM and beacon cadence for power-saving wireless clients
targets.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: AP beacon TIM->DTIM cadence->station wake->buffered group traffic
targets.failure_class: battery-sensitive clients miss timely multicast delivery
targets.evidence_pattern: OTA beacon TIM/DTIM fields and radio profile values
targets.remediation_path: balance DTIM interval with group traffic latency and station power save

targets.lesson_subject: HTTP portal Request Processing Rules and web-service activation boundary
targets.failure_class: portal requests routed to wrong handler after duplicated rules
targets.evidence_pattern: RPR entries, matcher collisions, applied webserver config
targets.remediation_path: remove verified duplicate and apply/restart process safely

targets.lesson_subject: Rogue Host group access and Forced Registration port-group enforcement
targets.failure_class: unregistered host reaches production or cannot reach registration portal
targets.evidence_pattern: host group status, RADIUS VLAN attributes, switch port group
targets.remediation_path: validate legacy mode, registration group and VLAN availability

targets.lesson_subject: Administrative HTTPS certificate selection and webserver startup trust
targets.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: System Access HTTPS cert->Apache listener->TLS chain->admin browser
targets.evidence_pattern: Apache debug log and HTTPS listener handshake
targets.remediation_path: restore valid HTTPS cert and use documented recovery procedure

targets.lesson_subject: Scheduled approval exemption and maximum secret request duration
targets.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: request->time schedule check->approval tiers or exemption->checkout lease
targets.evidence_pattern: approval profile schedule, audit, request state
targets.remediation_path: correct exemption window and approver minimum permission

targets.lesson_subject: Event Dropping versus drop-but-store licensing and correlation
targets.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: collector receive->drop rule->discard OR store without correlation->analytics
targets.failure_class: expected incident absent due to ingestion filter
targets.evidence_pattern: drop rule, raw search, EPS and rule match
targets.remediation_path: adjust precise event type/source regex and drop/store mode

targets.lesson_subject: Geofencing regional compliance tunnel connection priority
targets.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: source public IP geo->allow/deny->compliance match->ordered PoP/on-prem tunnel
targets.failure_class: users in permitted region cannot connect to intended PoP
targets.evidence_pattern: country mapping, rule publish status and tunnel sequence
targets.remediation_path: correct geography objects and compliance priority and verify propagation

targets.lesson_subject: Classifying health-check probes to protect SLA accuracy under congestion
targets.failure_class: false SLA failure caused by probe starvation during congestion
targets.evidence_pattern: health-check loss/jitter correlated with shaping queue saturation
targets.remediation_path: assign guaranteed bandwidth class to SLA probes and verify QoS
